bio.text: Jagdambika Pal is an Indian politician and advocate belonging to the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). He is currently serving as a member of the Lok Sabha representing the Domariyaganj constituency since 2009. Initially, he represented the Indian National Congress in the 15th Lok Sabha until his resignation on 7 March 2014, after which he joined the BJP and won subsequent elections.
